verdict.rationale: SendGrid's own docs include an SMTP getting-started guide stating it provides an SMTP service to deliver email through its servers, so a documented SMTP relay exists for apps that can't call the REST API. The evidence never shows how SMTP credentials are generated or what they are (e.g., an API key used as the password), and there are no host, port or TLS details. missing for 10: documented generation of SMTP credentials, SMTP connection details (host/port/TLS/auth), independent or hands-on corroboration of SMTP relay use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send through a documented SMTP relay with generated credentials when my framework or legacy app can't call the REST API

citations.quote: Twilio SendGrid provides an SMTP service to deliver your email using its servers.
How to send an Email with SMTP
